title: Director of Business Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: MUTOH's customers are sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and graphics producers—precisely Tedlar's target end users. The Director of Business Development would manage channel partnerships, distributor relationships, and strategic alliances. Partnering with DuPont Tedlar enables MUTOH to provide added value to their customer base by recommending a proven protective overlaminate that solves common pain points: UV degradation, graffiti damage on vehicle wraps, premature fading on outdoor signage, and high replacement costs. This partnership would strengthen MUTOH's customer relationships, increase stickiness with installers who need complete solutions, and create cross-selling opportunities at trade shows like PRINTING United and SEMA where both companies exhibit. This role owns revenue growth, partnership ROI, customer retention, and market expansion—all directly enhanced by offering Tedlar as part of MUTOH's solution ecosystem.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] manages MUTOH's channel partnerships, distributor network relationships, and strategic alliances that extend the company's market reach. They likely own partner revenue targets, co-selling initiatives, and ecosystem development strategy. This role reports to senior leadership (likely SVP Sales or Chief Commercial Officer) and collaborates cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and Sales teams to identify partnership opportunities that add value to MUTOH's customer base. They have decision authority over which partner solutions to recommend or bundle with MUTOH printers and which strategic relationships to prioritize for joint go-to-market initiatives.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: MUTOH's wide-format printers serve vehicle wrap installers, sign manufacturers, and outdoor graphics producers who face persistent challenges with graphic degradation, warranty claims, and customer dissatisfaction when printed output fails prematurely. Tedlar protective films directly address these pain points for MUTOH's end customers: (1) Vehicle Wraps & Fleet Graphics - Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor durability and graffiti resistance solve the warranty claim and premature replacement issues that plague wrap installers using standard overlaminates; (2) Outdoor Signage & Banners - Tedlar's UV protection eliminates the fading, yellowing, and cracking complaints that damage installer reputations and reduce repeat business; (3) ADA Compliant Signage - Tedlar's extreme temperature range and mold/mildew resistance ensure compliance signage maintains appearance and readability throughout its required lifespan. By partnering with Tedlar, [Name] can offer MUTOH customers a complete durability solution that differentiates MUTOH as the premium choice for outdoor applications and creates sticky customer relationships through superior total cost of ownership.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] likely owns metrics around partner-driven revenue growth, channel expansion, customer retention through value-added partnerships, and strategic alliance ROI. Their success depends on identifying partnerships that strengthen MUTOH's competitive position, increase customer lifetime value, and create new revenue streams without cannibalizing core printer sales. They care deeply about solving the most common pain points their customers face—because addressing these builds stronger distributor relationships and increases market share. Tedlar directly impacts their KPIs by: enabling upsell/cross-sell opportunities at the point of printer sale, reducing customer churn by solving the degradation problems that drive customers to competitors, creating co-marketing opportunities at PRINTING United and SEMA that generate qualified leads, and positioning MUTOH as a complete solutions provider rather than just a hardware vendor. [Name] also cares about partnerships that are easy to operationalize through existing channels and don't require extensive training or support overhead.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: MUTOH is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) and SEMA Show 2025, making this an ideal time to propose a strategic partnership that could be showcased at these events. The company recently launched new eco-solvent printers at PRINTING United 2024 and is preparing the HydrAton printer launch in 2025—indicating active product portfolio expansion where bundled solutions create differentiation. MUTOH has won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024 and has been honored by PRINTING United Alliance for 13 consecutive years, suggesting a company culture focused on innovation, quality, and industry leadership—values that align with Tedlar's premium positioning. The timing is optimal because [Name] is likely planning partnership strategies and trade show messaging for 2025 events right now, and MUTOH's customers are experiencing peak outdoor graphics season challenges that make protective film solutions highly relevant.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH's end customers (vehicle wrap installers and sign manufacturers) frequently face warranty claims and reputation damage when outdoor graphics printed on MUTOH equipment degrade prematurely due to inadequate overlaminates
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as a customer retention and competitive differentiation tool: 'Your customers are already investing in MUTOH's premium printing technology—Tedlar ensures their finished graphics perform at the same premium level for 12-20+ years, protecting both their reputation and yours.' Focus on how this partnership reduces customer churn and increases MUTOH's share of wallet.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH is exhibiting at both PRINTING United Expo 2025 and SEMA Show 2025, where complete solutions and live demonstrations drive qualified leads
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Propose a collaborative trade show presence: 'Imagine demonstrating a complete outdoor graphics solution at PRINTING United—MUTOH printer + Tedlar protection—with side-by-side weathering samples showing 10+ year performance. We could co-develop booth messaging and lead follow-up materials that position MUTOH as the only vendor offering true end-to-end durability.' Make the partnership immediately actionable and results-oriented.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH's recent Pinnacle Product Awards and 13-year recognition by PRINTING United Alliance demonstrate a company culture that values innovation and quality leadership—exactly the positioning required to recommend premium protective films over commodity alternatives
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Appeal to MUTOH's quality leadership positioning: 'MUTOH has built its reputation on premium innovation and proven performance. Partnering with Tedlar—the protective film with 60+ years of field-proven outdoor durability—reinforces that positioning with your customers and distributors. This isn't about adding another vendor; it's about completing your premium solution ecosystem with a material that matches your quality standards.' Frame this as brand alignment, not just product compatibility.

recommended_approach: Lead with customer value and partnership ROI, emphasizing how Tedlar solves the most common pain points MUTOH's customers face (UV degradation, warranty claims, premature replacements) while strengthening MUTOH's competitive differentiation. Position this as a strategic alliance opportunity tied to upcoming trade shows rather than a transactional product pitch. Use the second hook (trade show collaboration) as the primary call-to-action to create urgency and make the conversation immediately actionable.
